verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents role-based Shares that can restrict which tables/views are exposed (include patterns, preset roles like Explorer) enabling multi-team access control at the table level, but there is no evidence of column-level masking, row-level security policies, or dynamic data masking mechanisms. missing for 10: column-level masking policies, row-level security/filtering, and any granular attribute-based access control beyond table/view inclusion.
